correctness.rationale: In every cyclic lag, Fourier transforming the full modulation index makes each row a unit-norm character at frequency 2ds. Its row Gram eigenvalues are the cardinalities of slope residue classes modulo n/gcd(n,2d). The grouping identity counts each exact order \(m\mid n/\gcd(n,2)\) with multiplicity \(\gcd(n,2)\varphi(m)\), proving the complete singular law and explicit kernel. Simultaneous occupancy saturation gives the exact max rank and all equality cases. Coordinate projectors add precisely \(n-1\) directions; full linear tomography holds iff n odd prime. A separate real Hermitian basis construction confirms the identical singular values. Standalone CHECK.py passed 11,651 finite assertions and direct SVD comparisons; the proof does not infer infinite statements from them.

originality.rationale: The principal new claim is the all-subset complete nonzero singular spectrum, linear operator rank, explicit kernel and maximum identifiable dimensions for quadratic-chirp Fourier masks on all cyclic orders, including even orders and exact saturation-count laws. The closest published quadratic-chirp result supplies an odd-order fourth-overlap moment and balanced minimizers; that prior objective is explicitly credited rather than claimed. A general-random-mask PhaseLift result studies a distinct rank-one recovery problem. Residual priority risk from earlier uncatalogued operator-subspace formulations is acknowledged.

value.rationale: The full identifiable Hermitian-operator dimension and spectrum, with exact optimal slope selection for any number of quadratic Fourier masks, are natural quantitative invariants for deterministic coded diffraction and mixed-state tomography. Even orders exhibit a genuine information-saturation threshold after only \(n/2\) slopes, and all saturated designs are counted exactly. These formulas answer what this restricted physical mask family can and cannot measure without appealing to general downstream theorems. The odd-order fourth-overlap potential and prime-case MUB theory are prior work; they are not the claimed value source.
